text: {"name":"ble_get_addr_fields","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Initializes two outputs, selects address-related field values from the BLE context or a looked-up state object, and returns the lookup result.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"out_first_field","a2":"out_second_field","v2":"ble_context","result":"state_object"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":2,"meaning":"State-object payload begins here; this address is written to the first output."},{"offset":34,"meaning":"Context byte flag whose low bit selects the state-object lookup; its address is returned in the alternate path."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"Context 16-bit sentinel field; its address is used for the second output when the value is not 0xFFFF."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"State-object dword copied to the second output when a lookup succeeds."}]}
